properties.comment: This is a message from Volunteer Energy Cooperative. Please be advised that a planned power outage will occur in your area on Wednesday, October 14th beginning at 9:00 AM and lasting until approximately 10:00 AM. This outage is necessary to allow crews to safely balance load and perform maintenance in preparation for upcoming winter months. We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your patience. Thank you.
